subject: LDT
body: Deutschland ist ein … (Germany is a …)
explanation: Germany is a democratic state under the rule of law.

subject: LDT
body: Wie heißt die deutsche Verfassung? (What is the German constitution called?)
explanation: The Basic Law (Grundgesetz).

subject: LDT
body: Seit wann gibt es das Grundgesetz? (Since when has the Basic Law existed?)
explanation: It came into force on 23 May 1949.

subject: LDT
body: Was steht in Artikel 1 des Grundgesetzes? (What does Article 1 say?)
options: Die Würde des Menschen ist unantastbar.
Der Staat steht über jedem Menschen.
explanation: 'Human dignity shall be inviolable.'

subject: LDT
body: Wie viele Bundesländer hat Deutschland? (How many federal states?)
explanation: Including the city-states Berlin, Hamburg and Bremen.

subject: LDT
body: Was ist die Hauptstadt von Deutschland? (Capital?)
explanation: Bonn was the capital of West Germany.

subject: LDT
body: Wer ist das Staatsoberhaupt? (Head of state?)
explanation: The Federal Chancellor leads the government.

subject: LDT
body: Wer leitet die Bundesregierung? (Who leads the federal government?)
explanation: The Chancellor sets the guidelines of policy.

subject: LDT
body: Wer wählt den Bundeskanzler? (Who elects the Chancellor?)
explanation: Members of the Bundestag elect the Chancellor.

subject: LDT
body: Wer wählt den Bundespräsidenten? (Who elects the Federal President?)
explanation: The Federal Convention, for five years.

subject: LDT
body: Wie oft wird der Bundestag normalerweise gewählt? (How often is the Bundestag elected?)
explanation: Every four years.

subject: LDT
body: Ab welchem Alter darf man den Bundestag wählen? (Voting age for the Bundestag?)
explanation: Some states allow voting from 16 in local or state elections.

subject: LDT
body: Wahlen in Deutschland sind … (Elections in Germany are …)
explanation: Also universal and direct.

subject: LDT
body: Was bedeutet Gewaltenteilung? (Separation of powers means …)
explanation: Lawmaking, government and courts are separate.

subject: LDT
body: Wo sitzt das Bundesverfassungsgericht? (Seat of the Federal Constitutional Court?)
explanation: It protects the Basic Law.

subject: LDT
body: Wer ist in Deutschland für die Schulen zuständig? (Who is responsible for schools?)
explanation: Education is a matter for the states.

subject: LDT
body: Männer und Frauen sind in Deutschland … (Men and women in Germany are …)
explanation: Article 3 of the Basic Law.

subject: LDT
body: Was gilt für die Religion? (What applies to religion?)
options: Man darf sie nur einmal wechseln.
Ohne Religion darf man nicht wählen.
explanation: Freedom of religion, Article 4. Having no religion is also allowed.

subject: LDT
body: Gibt es in Deutschland eine Schulpflicht? (Is school compulsory?)
explanation: Compulsory schooling applies to all children living in Germany.

subject: LDT
body: Was muss man vom Einkommen bezahlen? (What do you pay from your income?)
explanation: Taxes plus social insurance contributions.

subject: LDT
body: Was ist die Amtssprache in Deutschland? (Official language?)
explanation: German. Some regional minority languages are protected too.

subject: LDT
body: Welche Farben hat die deutsche Flagge? (Colours of the flag?)
explanation: Black, red and gold.

subject: LDT
body: Wann ist der Tag der Deutschen Einheit? (Day of German Unity?)
explanation: Reunification took place on 3 October 1990.

subject: LDT
body: Wann fiel die Berliner Mauer? (When did the Berlin Wall fall?)
explanation: The Wall was built in 1961 and fell on 9 November 1989.

subject: LDT
body: In welchem Jahr wurde Deutschland wiedervereinigt? (Year of reunification?)
explanation: 3 October 1990.

subject: LDT
body: Wann war die Zeit des Nationalsozialismus? (When was the Nazi dictatorship?)
explanation: It ended with Germany's defeat in 1945.

subject: LDT
body: 1957 wurden die Römischen Verträge unterschrieben. Was entstand daraus? (The 1957 Treaties of Rome created …)
explanation: The EEC, forerunner of the EU. Germany was a founding member.

subject: LDT
body: Seit wann gibt es den Euro als Bargeld in Deutschland? (Euro cash since?)
explanation: The euro existed from 1999 for transfers; cash came in 2002.

subject: LDT
body: Wie viele Nachbarländer hat Deutschland? (How many neighbouring countries?)
explanation: Denmark, Poland, Czechia, Austria, Switzerland, France, Luxembourg, Belgium and the Netherlands.

subject: LDT
body: Wie viele Fragen muss man im Einbürgerungstest richtig haben? (How many correct answers for citizenship?)
explanation: 15 of 33 passes the integration-course test; citizenship needs 17.
